context: Two sisters reminisce about a sparkling event from their youth
purpose: Teach: 判ら/ヘルプ/あいまい/ステキ/ジョーク/ボリューム/終始/輝く

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、あの夏祭りのこと覚えてる？花火が空いっぱいに輝いてたよね。
lines.en: Hey, do you remember that summer festival? The fireworks were sparkling all across the sky.
lines.style: Warm nostalgic tone, soft and reflective like reminiscing fondly.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: もちろん覚えてる。正直、細かいところは記憶があいまいだけど、本当にステキな夜だったよね。
lines.en: Of course I remember. Honestly, the details are hazy, but it really was a wonderful night.
lines.style: Gentle and dreamy, slightly chuckling as memories surface.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんが終始上機嫌でさ、軽いジョークばっかり飛ばしてたの、覚えてる？
lines.en: Dad was in a great mood the whole time, cracking light jokes nonstop, you remember?
lines.style: Laughing fondly, a bit playful as she imitates their father.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: わかるわかる！声のボリュームがどんどん大きくなって、お母さんが「静かに」って何度も言ってたよね。
lines.en: I totally get it! His voice volume kept getting louder, and mom kept telling him to quiet down.
lines.style: Bright and animated, voice rising with delight at the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 私、迷子になって泣いてたら、知らないおじさんが「ヘルプが必要かな？」って優しく声をかけてくれたの。
lines.en: When I got lost and was crying, a kind stranger gently asked if I needed help.
lines.style: Softer voice, slightly emotional remembering a kind moment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 今でもなぜあの人があんなに優しかったのか判らないけど、本当にありがたかったよね。
lines.en: Even now I don't understand why that person was so kind, but we were really grateful.
lines.style: Tender and sincere, voice catching with quiet emotion.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 見つかった瞬間のお姉ちゃんの顔、目が輝いてて今でもはっきり覚えてる。
lines.en: The moment you found me, your eyes were sparkling — I still remember it clearly.
lines.style: Wistful and warm, voice softening with affection.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: また家族みんなで集まろうよ。きっとあの夜みたいに、また何かがステキに輝くから。
lines.en: Let's all get together as a family again. Surely something will sparkle wonderfully like that night.
lines.style: Hopeful and gentle, inviting tone with quiet conviction.
